title: ART of PIV: Agentic Real-Time Particle Image Velocimetry for Active Flow Control
abstract: arXiv:2610.41304v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Particle image velocimetry (PIV) measures fluid motion from images of tracer particles, but its accuracy depends on choices throughout the estimation pipeline, including image preprocessing, flow estimation, and postprocessing. These choices are typically left to expert tuning, and a fixed configuration can become less accurate as conditions change. This matters especially when PIV supplies feedback for real-time control, where measurements must be both accurate and fast, and flow conditions vary. We introduce ART of PIV -- short for Agentic Real-Time and also a nod to the art of tuning a PIV pipeline -- which automates pipeline choice for each image pair. A learned agent selects a configuration according to a chosen measurement objective from a library assembled for a specified speed budget. Across cross-correlation, classical optical-flow, and learning-based estimators, ART of PIV reduces average end-point error (AEPE) by 12.2-22.4 %

translated_title: ART of PIV：面向主动流动控制的智能体式实时粒子图像测速
translated_abstract: 粒子图像测速（PIV）通过示踪粒子的图像来测量流体运动，但其精度取决于估计流程中各个环节的选择，包括图像预处理、流场估计和后处理。这些选择通常需要专家手动调优，且固定的配置在条件变化时精度可能下降。当PIV为实时控制提供反馈时，这一点尤为关键，因为此时测量既要准确又要快速，且流动条件不断变化。我们提出了ART of PIV——它是“智能体式实时”的缩写，同时也致敬了PIV流程调优的“艺术”——该方法可为每对图像自动选择处理流程。一个经过学习的智能体根据所选定的测量目标，从为特定速度预算构建的配置库中选择一种配置。在互相关、经典光流以及基于学习的估计器上，ART of PIV将平均端点误差（AEPE）降低了12.2%–22.4%。
tldr: ART of PIV利用学习型智能体根据测量目标为每对PIV图像自动选择最优处理流程配置，在满足速度预算的前提下将平均端点误差降低12.2%–22.4%，实现了面向实时流动控制的快速准确测速。
en_tdlr: ART of PIV employs a learned agent to automatically select the optimal PIV pipeline configuration for each image pair according to the measurement objective, reducing average end-point error by 12.2–22.4% under a speed budget, enabling fast and accurate measurements for real-time active flow control.
